Only one hypothesis is returned although three were requested: the evidence supports a single Brand-specific initiative, the Sock Library, and the other formats (behind-the-scenes episode, follow-up) rest on that same initiative so they are folded into the one hypothesis. The shop page alone gives only generic product facts that would work for any sock brand. Strongest counterargument: thin evidence of one brand-described program, no known creator-partnership history, no usage numbers, and Norway-style routes that may not match the creator's regions. Open unknowns: creator collaboration openness, budget, current program status. Next safe action: human review of the artifacts and the fit before any outreach composition. Schema and evidence-chain validators were not run in this runtime, so no validation is claimed."}
